p.s: To: Mrs. Smith
Thank you for your letter, which arrived on second.
June.
I am very pleased to help to organize this Conference in our College, which will hold at Conference Centre at Bromley College starting on 20th June for 3 days.
please find information your required as follows:
We have booked the hotel for the group.

Called "palace Hotel" which is about 10 miles away from our College, the hotel will have a coach to pick the group up from the airport on 19th of June and then take the group to Conference and return to hotel every day.
Regarding to the end-of-conference party.
We have planed a barbecue at 5 oo pm. on our most idyllic play field which is over looking the endless Countryside and farms.
At 7:00pm.
we can move to our student hall to have a disc dance until 10:00pm.
On the last day, we have arranged a small party in the hotel, then we all set up to have a sightseeing Bromley town center for about two hours before you leave for airport.
Bromley town center is the most beautiful shopping centre in South East London.
There are many historical buildings remain.
I think the students will enjoy this sightseeing .
If any further discussion, please let me know.
Yours.
sincerely,
